name: airtable
description: Read and write Airtable bases, tables, and records. Enables AI assistants to query, create, and update rows in Airtable through the Airtable API.

AIRTABLE_API_KEY.description: Airtable personal access token (starts with pat...). Create one at https://airtable.com/create/tokens with scopes: schema.bases:read, data.records:read, and optionally write scopes.
